[SWS_LinTrcv_00135] ⌈Enabled: If the function LinTrcv_SetWakeupMode is called
with TrcvWakupMode == LINTRCV_WUMODE_ENABLE and if the LinTrcv module
has a stored wakeup event pending for the addressed bus, the LinTrcv module shall
execute the notification within the API call or immediately after (depending on the im-
plementation).⌋
